map.三种情况：一是进程处于不可中断睡眠（D 状态，通常在等 I/O 或网络文件系统）: Three cases. First, the process is in uninterruptible sleep (D state, usually waiting on I/O or a network filesystem), and the signal is only handled once it returns to the kernel. Second, you killed a child process and the parent respawned it. Third, you lack permission (you are neither the owner nor root). Check the state and parent process first and act accordingly instead of repeating -9.
